title: Three AI models shopped a Shopify catalog and each picked a different winner

drafts.text: Three AI models shopped a Shopify catalog, and each picked a different winner (Search Engine Journal, 2 Nov 2026). A readiness scan tells a store whether crawlers can reach its pages. It does not tell the store which product an assistant picks.

Three AI models shopped a Shopify catalog, and each picked a different winner. That is the headline from Search Engine Journal on 2 November 2026.

A readiness scan answers a narrower question. It tells a store whether crawlers can reach its pages and whether those pages carry the signals a model can read. It does not tell the store which product a model will pick, and it should not be read that way.

On Monday I would check which product pages a model can read at all, before arguing over which one it chose.

Method note: headline and summary of one Search Engine Journal article, 2 Nov 2026. We have not checked its models, prompts or number of runs. Confidence: low.
